description: This chart illustrates the distribution of responses across three categories – Deceived, Partially, and Not Deceived – for two different levels of ambiguity, labeled “Ambiguity 1 (Outer)” and “Ambiguity 2 (Inner)”. The chart consists of six slices in total, three for each ambiguity level. For Ambiguity 1 (Outer), the slices are red (Deceived, 67.6%), yellow (Partially, 57.9%), and green (Not Deceived, 10.5%). For Ambiguity 2 (Inner), the slices are red (Deceived, 31.6%), yellow (Partially, 23.5%), and green (Not Deceived, 8.8%). A legend is provided to identify the color coding for each category. Percentage labels are displayed within each slice. The slices appear to be ordered by decreasing proportion within each ambiguity level, starting with the red “Deceived” slice and moving to the green “Not Deceived” slice.
